title: proflow configuration
description: Guard rules for the proflow harness mod. Read from ~/.commandcode/proflow.json(c) and .commandcode/proflow.json(c); built-in rules always apply and these layers add to (or waive) them.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor autocomplete and validation.

deny.description: Regular expressions for commands to hard-block before execution.

confirm.description: Regular expressions for commands that require confirmation.

allow.description: Regular expressions exempt from the deny and confirm tiers.
